facts.fact: Onix Data Centres says its Accra facility, with Module 1 fully operational, takes its power from its own 2,200-panel solar farm (640 kW peak) by day and the grid at night, with 3 x 456 kW generators as backup.

GHA.note: No PUE and no water use figure stated; groundwater by reverse osmosis is a source, not a published usage figure.

facts.fact: Onix Data Centres says its Accra facility, with Module 1 fully operational, offers hot desks, office rental, cross connects and a meet-me room to business customers.
Onix Data Centres says its Accra facility is Tier IV certified by the Uptime Institute.

GHA.note: Only one facility named; cross connects to AWS and Azure are not a cloud region.
Document mentions cross connects to internet exchanges generally, but states no exchange point in Ghana.
Document is not about national ID.
Document is not about government IT staff.
Document does not state who owns Onix.
